sdk_measured: rmcp 1.1.0 with client feature, default features disabled
protocol_context: Official current specification is 2026-07-28; measured SDK model is rmcp 1.1.0, not a current-version interoperability test.
cpu: Intel Core i5-13600K, taskset logical CPU 2; frequency not locked
method: 31 interleaved rounds, shuffled variants each round; warmed blocks target 3ms; paired ratios versus same-round baseline
stream: Prebuilt Bytes chunks, tokio_stream::iter, current-thread Tokio runtime; no sockets/TLS/HTTP/proxy/business execution
scope: 15 payload/framing/chunk scenarios; SSE parse and SSE plus serde_json to ServerJsonRpcMessage measured separately; 6 encoding scenarios
metrics: p10/p90 are paired ratio quantiles, not confidence intervals. JSON-only bypasses both SSE and stream/input work; not an exact flamegraph share.
tests: Generic encoder byte-for-byte equivalence on 320 field/value/retry combinations; all measured messages parse successfully and event counts match; all three encoders agree on all fixture messages.
screening: Earlier screen used a hand-written data/id-only reserved encoder. Reported final results use the general From<Sse> reservation patch. Only final results included in measurements.csv.
